📡 Iran embassy in Caracas reaffirms ‘deep and historic’ ties with Venezuela

📌 Tehran, IRNA – The Embassy of the Islamic Republic of Iran in Caracas has reaffirmed the “deep and historic” relations between Iran and Venezuela, stressing that the longstanding partnership is rooted in mutual respect, solidarity between the two nations, and their shared determination to safeguard independence, national sovereignty, and the right to self-determination.

In a statement published in Persian and Spanish on its official Telegram channel and X account on Wednesday, the embassy commemorated the birth anniversary of late Venezuelan leader Hugo Chavez, paying tribute to his legacy and his enduring role in establishing and expanding the “brotherly and exemplary” relations between both revolutionary nations.
​
The embassy said the bilateral relationship has consistently been targeted by enemies seeking to undermine it, particularly through media campaigns.
​
It said the latest example involved “the incomplete and out-of-context reflection of part of an interview” by Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi regarding US military aggression and pressure against independent nations, including Iran and Venezuela.
​
“Some media outlets have sought, by selectively editing the remarks and presenting an interpretation contrary to the speaker’s original intent, to create misunderstanding and disrupt the historic relations between the two countries,” the statement read.
​
The embassy clarified that Araghchi’s remarks “in no way contained disrespect or a negative judgment” toward the Venezuelan people, the country’s legal institutions, officials, or national sovereignty.
​
The Venezuelan government and people, it added, have always enjoyed Iran’s profound respect and the Iranian government has consistently admired the Venezuelan nation’s historic resistance in defense of its independence and sovereignty.
​
The statement further said the strong bond between Iran’s Islamic Revolution and Venezuela’s Bolivarian Revolution, founded on shared ideals of independence, justice, opposition to domination, and mutual respect, would not be harmed by divisive media campaigns.
​
The embassy concluded by reaffirming that more than seven decades of Iran–Venezuela relations have been based on internationally recognized principles, including sovereign equality, political independence, non-interference in internal affairs, mutual respect, and respect for national sovereignty, and would continue to expand on the same foundations.

OpenAI launches Health in ChatGPT

Health is a new mode in which the chatbot gains access to your medical records and Apple Watch data to answer health-related questions based on your actual metrics.

Users can connect Apple Health along with medical records from hospital systems, One Medical, or Function Health. Once linked, ChatGPT can view lab results, medications, recent doctor visits, sleep, and activity data. It can compare a new blood test with previous ones, explain unclear terms from discharge summaries, or even recommend restaurants while taking allergies into account.

According to OpenAI’s own statistics, 300 million people already ask ChatGPT about health every week. Among early testers, 70% of these conversations began outside a dedicated medical section. For this reason, the relevant context is now pulled directly into regular chats without the need to switch modes.

Dedicated models have been assigned to the feature. Free users get access to GPT-5.5 Instant, which has improved recognition of situations that require a real doctor. Paid users receive GPT-5.6 Sol, which handles complex cases more accurately and explains lab results more effectively.
Data from medical records and Apple Health is not used for model training or advertising targeting. It is stored with additional encryption, can be disconnected at any time, and synchronized records are deleted within 30 days.

The feature is currently available only in the United States, on web and iOS, for users aged 18 and older on the Free, Go, Plus, and Pro plans. It is not available in Codex.

A company buys its own stock back from the open market, so fewer of those shares stay in circulation. That makes each remaining shareholder's slice of the company a little bigger.

🚨BREAKING: A revolutionary new cancer treatment called Histotripsy is showing incredible promise by literally liquefying tumors using focused sound waves—no surgery, no chemo, and no radiation needed.

Developed by pioneers Dr. Zhen Xu and the late Dr. Charles Cain at the University of Michigan, this FDA-approved technology is now being used at leading hospitals like Johns Hopkins and the Cleveland Clinic.

How it works:
- A robotic arm delivers precise high-intensity ultrasound waves straight to the tumor.
- These waves create tiny gas bubbles inside cancer cells that rapidly expand and collapse.
- The mechanical force destroys the tumor cells, turning the mass into liquid debris that the body naturally clears away.
- It also appears to stimulate the immune system to better recognize and attack remaining cancer cells.
- Because it relies on mechanical disruption rather than heat or radiation, it spares healthy surrounding tissue.

Patients often undergo the quick outpatient procedure and go home the same day. It is currently treating liver tumors, with trials expanding to kidney and brain cancers.

This could be a game-changer in the fight against cancer.
